http/websocket_handshake#

The WebSocket opening handshake (RFC 6455 §4): the client's Upgrade request, the server's 101, and subprotocols.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The WebSocket opening handshake (RFC 6455 §4): the client's Upgrade request, the server's 101, and subprotocols. The client and server modules use it.

Public API#

object WebSocketProtocols#

object WebSocketProtocols

Subprotocol names, as Sec-WebSocket-Protocol lists them.

WebSocketProtocols.WebSocketProtocols#

WebSocketProtocols(origin is @string)

The names, at most 32; WebSocketFailure for one that is not a token, or a repeat.

WebSocketProtocols.values#

values() is @string

The names, in order.

WebSocketProtocols.string#

string() is string

The names joined with , .

WebSocketProtocols.contains#

contains(value is string) is bool

Whether value is one of them.

object WebSocketClientHandshake#

object WebSocketClientHandshake

The client's half of the handshake.

WebSocketClientHandshake.WebSocketClientHandshake#

WebSocketClientHandshake(url is UrlParts, protocols is @string, headers is Headers, nonce is @byte)

A handshake to url offering protocols, with headers and a 16-byte nonce.

WebSocketClientHandshake.request#

request() is Request

The GET with Upgrade, the key and the protocols.

WebSocketClientHandshake.selected#

selected(response is Response) is string

The subprotocol response chose ("" for none); WebSocketFailure when the answer is not a valid 101 for this key.

object WebSocketServerHandshake#

object WebSocketServerHandshake

Protocol validation only. Caller must authorize Origin before writing response.

WebSocketServerHandshake.WebSocketServerHandshake#

WebSocketServerHandshake(request is Http1RequestHead)

Checks request as an upgrade; WebSocketFailure when it is not one.

WebSocketServerHandshake.protocols#

protocols() is @string

The subprotocols the client offered.

WebSocketServerHandshake.response#

response(protocol is string) is Response

The 101 that accepts it with protocol ("" for none).
